reports.notes: Handwritten print, clear. The form is the combined '2014 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES' sheet (side rail 'COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES') - that is the FORM title only; the Office Seeking field states 'County Commissioner Seat A', a county office, so NO school-board scope flag applies. Amounts carry no dollar signs and no thousands commas; transcribed as written. The digit readings on line 1 were confirmed by enlarging the cells (2725.75 / 4656.61) - this filer's 7 has no crossbar and can look like a 1 at page scale. Lines 3 and 7 are the filer's struck-through zero glyph, transcribed '0' at medium confidence. Office Seeking 'County Commissioner Seat A' AGREES with office_index 'County Commission Seat A'. candidate_index was blank; cover and verification block both name Gregory J. Graves. Clerk Date received stamp 'OCT 27 PM 4:23'. Page box reads 'Page 1 of 3'.
